name: Go 9x9 policy strength
objective: Improve 9x9 Go strength against frozen opponents under equal search and inference compute.

evaluation.seed_policy: paired colors and matched search seeds

fairness: same starting checkpoint, self-play games and training compute
same visits, threads, hardware class and time limits
paired colors against every frozen opponent
identical rules, komi and resignation policy
integrity: illegal move or protocol failure counts as a loss
retain SGFs and GTP logs for every game
flag color imbalance and anomalous win-rate jumps for audit
